caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate vase presented in a vertical orientation. The vase is primarily rendered in shades of off-white and gray, giving it a sculpted, marble-like appearance. Decoratively, it features blue accents: a patch around the flaring rim and a background behind an elaborate floral and fruit motif prominently positioned at the center front of the vase. The main decorative motif includes a basket filled with intricately detailed flowers and foliage, all in white relief set against the blue background. On either side of the central motif, raised clusters of white grapes and leaves are depicted as part of the vase's surface design. The drawing appears to be executed in colored pencil or watercolor on a light beige paper background, and the borders of the artwork are faintly marked. The artist's name, Katherine Merrill, is written in the lower right corner.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
